## Objective
Replace the three contract stubs with real implementations so the whole Snake engine works without a DOM: `src/game.js` (pure rules on an immutable state object), `src/ui.js` (key mapping and canvas drawing through a minimal context), and `src/app.js` (a controller that combines them with pause, restart, speed and a persisted best score). A separate task builds the HTML page and `src/main.js` that wire these to a real canvas, keyboard and timer, so these modules must never touch `document`, `window`, `localStorage` or timers.

## Interface
Exactly the exports, signatures and JSDoc typedefs declared in the stubs `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/app.js` (read them; keep the typedefs, delete the `CONTRACT_STUB` header line and the throwing bodies). Plain ES modules, `export function` / `export const` only, no default exports, no dependencies. Imports allowed: `src/ui.js` and `src/app.js` may import from sibling files with relative `./x.js` paths; `src/game.js` imports nothing.

Constants to use (internal to `src/ui.js`, not exported): background `#0f172a`, food `#ef4444`, snake body `#22c55e`, snake head `#4ade80`, overlay scrim `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)`, overlay text `#f8fafc`.

## Behavior
`src/game.js`:
1. `createGame({ width = 20, height = 20, rng = Math.random } = {})` throws `RangeError` unless `width` and `height` are integers `>= 5`. It returns a state with the snake of length 3 whose head is at `(Math.floor(width / 2), Math.floor(height / 2))` and whose other two segments are the cells immediately to the left of the head, `direction` and `nextDirection` `'right'`, `score` 0, `status` `'running'`, and one food item.
2. Food placement: list every grid cell not occupied by the snake in row-major order (y ascending, then x ascending); choose index `Math.floor(rng() * count)` clamped to `count - 1`. With no free cell the food is `null`. `rng` is called once per placement and nowhere else.
3. `setDirection(state, direction)` returns a new state with `nextDirection` set, except it returns the input state unchanged when: `direction` is not one of `'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'`; the status is not `'running'`; or `direction` is the exact opposite of `state.direction` (the direction of the last applied move, not the pending one). Setting the same direction again is a no-op.
4. `step(state, rng = Math.random)`: if status is not `'running'` return the input state. Otherwise compute the new head by moving the head one cell along `nextDirection` (`up` is y-1, `down` y+1, `left` x-1, `right` x+1).
5. If the new head is outside the grid, or equals any cell of `snake.slice(0, -1)` (the tail cell is excluded because it moves away on the same tick), return a copy of the input state with only `status` changed to `'over'`: snake, direction, food and score unchanged.
6. If the new head equals the food: the snake grows (new head prepended, tail kept), `score` increases by 1, and new food is placed by rule 2 on the grown snake. If no free cell remains, `food` is `null` and `status` is `'won'`.
7. Otherwise: the new head is prepended and the tail removed (length unchanged). In both non-collision cases `direction` becomes the applied `nextDirection`.
8. `tickDelay(score)` returns `Math.max(60, 150 - 5 * score)`.
9. No function mutates its inputs (including the `snake` array and its points); each returns new objects for anything it changes.

`src/ui.js`:
10. `keyToDirection(key)`: `ArrowUp`/`w`/`W` give `'up'`, `ArrowDown`/`s`/`S` give `'down'`, `ArrowLeft`/`a`/`A` give `'left'`, `ArrowRight`/`d`/`D` give `'right'`; anything else gives `null`.
11. `draw(ctx, state, cellSize, options = {})` uses only `ctx.fillStyle`, `ctx.font`, `ctx.textAlign`, `ctx.textBaseline`, `ctx.fillRect`, `ctx.fillText`. With `W = state.width * cellSize` and `H = state.height * cellSize`, in this order: (a) set background fill and call `fillRect(0, 0, W, H)`; (b) if `state.food` is not null, set food fill and draw its cell; (c) draw snake body segments (indices 1 and up) in the body color, then the head (index 0) in the head color. A cell at grid `(gx, gy)` is drawn as `fillRect(gx * cellSize + 1, gy * cellSize + 1, cellSize - 2, cellSize - 2)`.
12. Overlay, after the board: the message is `'Game Over'` when `state.status === 'over'`, else `'You Win!'` when `'won'`, else `'Paused'` when `options.paused` is true, else none. With a message: set the scrim fill and `fillRect(0, 0, W, H)`; then set the text fill, `font` to `bold ${Math.floor(cellSize * 1.5)}px sans-serif`, `textAlign` `'center'`, `textBaseline` `'middle'`, and call `fillText(message, W / 2, H / 2)`. Without a message `fillText` is never called. `draw` does not mutate `state`.

`src/app.js`:
13. `createApp(options)` builds the game with `createGame({ width: gridWidth, height: gridHeight, rng })` (defaults `gridWidth` 20, `gridHeight` 20, `cellSize` 20, `rng` `Math.random`); reads the best score from `storage` key `'snake.best'` (a base-10 string of a non-negative integer, otherwise 0; a `getItem` that throws or an absent or null `storage` also gives 0); is not paused; draws once; calls `onChange` once with the initial view.
14. `getView()` returns `{ score, best, status }` where `status` is `'paused'` if the app is paused and the game is running, otherwise the game's status. `getState()` returns the current game state object.
15. `tick()`: does nothing (no draw, no `onChange`) when paused or when the game status is not `'running'`. Otherwise it applies `step(state, rng)`; if the score now exceeds `best`, it sets `best` to the score and calls `storage.setItem('snake.best', String(best))` inside a try/catch that swallows errors; then redraws and calls `onChange` with the view.
16. `nextDelay()` returns `tickDelay(score)`.
17. `handleKey(key)` returns `true` for a recognised key and `false` otherwise. A movement key (per `keyToDirection`) applies `setDirection` unless paused (when paused it is ignored but still returns `true`); it does not redraw or call `onChange`. `' '` restarts when the game status is `'over'` or `'won'`, otherwise toggles pause. `'p'` and `'P'` toggle pause. `'Enter'`, `'r'` and `'R'` restart.
18. `togglePause()` does nothing unless the game status is `'running'`; otherwise it flips the paused flag, redraws with `{ paused }` and calls `onChange`.
19. `restart()` creates a fresh game with the same options, clears the paused flag, keeps `best`, redraws and calls `onChange`.
20. Every redraw calls `draw(ctx, state, cellSize, { paused })` from `src/ui.js`.

## Invariants
- The three test files `test/game.test.js`, `test/ui.test.js`, `test/app.test.js` must stay byte-identical and all pass; if one seems to contradict this spec, follow the spec's literal wording for the interpretation and do not edit the test.
- Pure modules: no `document`, `window`, `localStorage`, `setTimeout`, `Date`, `fetch` or any global except `Math` and the `rng`/`storage`/`ctx` passed in.
- Code style: 2-space indent, single quotes, semicolons, `const` by default, small functions with a one-line JSDoc where the stub did not already provide one.

## Edge cases
- Snake of length 1: `snake.slice(0, -1)` is empty, so only walls can end the game.
- `rng` returning exactly 1 (out of contract) must not index past the end: clamp.
- Moving onto the tail cell that is leaving is legal; moving onto any other body cell, including the neck, is a collision. Reversal into the neck is prevented by `setDirection`, so `step` does not special-case it.
- Two direction keys pressed within one tick: the second is judged against the last applied `direction`, so `up` then `left` from a rightward snake leaves `up` pending.
- Pressing `' '` while paused and running resumes; pressing it after game over restarts instead of pausing.
- `onChange` may be absent; never call it unguarded.

## Guardrails
- Create only `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/app.js`. Do not touch `test/`, `index.html`, `src/main.js`, `package.json`, `scripts/` or any other file (another task owns them).
- Do not leave the `CONTRACT_STUB` marker anywhere in these files.
- Do not add dependencies or a build step; browsers load these files directly as ES modules, so imports must use relative paths with the `.js` extension.
- Do not export extra helpers that tests or other tasks might start depending on; keep helpers module-private.

## Out of scope
The HTML page, CSS, `src/main.js`, the static dev server, `package.json`, README, touch or swipe controls, sound, obstacles or multiple levels.
